content: We also propose orthogonal regularization, which explicitly encourages the delimiter-generating decoder states to be different from each other. This is inspired by BIBREF32 , who use orthogonal regularization to encourage representations across domains to be as distinct as possible. Specifically, we stack the decoder hidden states corresponding to delimiters together to form matrix INLINEFORM0 and use the following equation as the orthogonal regularization loss: DISPLAYFORM0
